newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD says Japan undersea cable to cost 130 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: KDD says Japan undersea cable to cost 130 bln yen.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd said on Thursday that the total construction cost of its large-capacity undersea optic fibre cable around Japan's three main islands would be 130 billion yen.
KDD said in a statement that construction would start in the middle of this year and the system would begin operating at the end of March 1999.
The statement gave no further details.
KDD, Japan's largest international telecommunications carrier, said in October that it would invest 100 billion yen in the 8,500 km cable around the islands of Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu.
It said the cable would have a capacity of 100 gigabits, or 1.2 million phone lines, and help it lower its international call charges.
